description: This file contains functions related to upgrading firmware images for various devices based on their board name. It includes a check function, and a main upgrade dispatch function that selects the appropriate upgrade method depending on the device identified by its board name.

methods.name: platform_check_image
methods.description: A function that checks the image; currently always returns success.

methods.name: platform_do_upgrade
methods.description: Performs firmware upgrade by selecting the appropriate upgrade method based on the device's board name.
